name: hullMass
notes: Repeat module = InstancedMesh with per-instance part masks (greebles/fins/masts), placed along a plan-view bow; prow cap, stepped stern and gate arches merged into one mesh; lights = one Points set (cool white, beacons blink via update(time)). Local frame: prow tip at z=0, stern at z=-lengthMetres, hull on +X (side=1) or mirrored (side=-1); nearest surface 42 m from the axis, arches apex 48 m above it.
